# WikiPathways

> WikiPathways is an open-science, community-curated database of biological pathways with interactive visualization and semantic web access.

WikiPathways provides a collaborative platform for creating, editing, and sharing pathway maps across multiple organisms including Homo sapiens and Mus musculus. The platform supports multiple data formats (GPML, GMT, RDF) and integrates with bioinformatics tools for pathway analysis and systems biology research.

## Key Topics

- Biological pathways
- Pathway visualization

## Getting Started

- [Home](https://www.wikipathways.org): WikiPathways homepage: open-science pathway database with GPML visualization
- [About](https://www.wikipathways.org/about.html): About WikiPathways: collaborative pathway curation platform vs KEGG/Reactome
- [Help](https://www.wikipathways.org/help.html): WikiPathways help: viewer guide, editing tutorials, community participation
- [Cite](https://www.wikipathways.org/cite.html): How to cite WikiPathways: citation guide with DOI and academic attribution

## Browse & Discover Pathways

- [Table](https://www.wikipathways.org/browse/table.html): WikiPathways browsable table: searchable directory of pathways across organisms
- [Organisms](https://www.wikipathways.org/browse/organisms.html): WikiPathways organisms: index of pathways across model organisms and species
- [Filters](https://www.wikipathways.org/browse/filters.html): WikiPathways pathway filters: organism, ontology, disease, and metadata filtering
- [Annotations](https://www.wikipathways.org/browse/annotations.html): WikiPathways annotations: Pathway/Disease/Cell Type Ontology browse interface
- [Communities](https://www.wikipathways.org/browse/communities.html): WikiPathways research communities: COVID-19, CPTAC, disease-specific pathways
- [New Pathways](https://www.wikipathways.org/browse/new.html): New WikiPathways: recently added pathways across organisms and diseases
- [Recently Updated](https://www.wikipathways.org/browse/updated.html): Recently updated WikiPathways: date-sorted pathway updates and revisions
- [Cited in Literature](https://www.wikipathways.org/browse/citedin.html): WikiPathways cited pathways: literature-referenced pathways by organism

## Data Access & Integration

- [Download](https://www.wikipathways.org/download.html): Download WikiPathways: GPML, GMT, RDF formats and programmatic API access
- [Semantic Web Portal](https://www.wikipathways.org/rdf.html): WikiPathways RDF/SPARQL: semantic web and linked data pathway access
- [Tools](https://www.wikipathways.org/tools.html): WikiPathways tools: integrated bioinformatics and pathway analysis software

## Community & Contributors

- [Authors Directory](https://www.wikipathways.org/browse/authors.html): WikiPathways authors directory: alphabetical index of pathway contributors
- [Alexandra Valeanu](https://www.wikipathways.org/authors/Alval.html): Alexandra Valeanu profile: rare disease and copy-number variation pathways
